g.text: Table S1 | Clinical characteristics by treatment arm
P values compare the two cohorts overall. Age: Mann–Whitney; categorical variables: Pearson, missing excluded.
Continuous variables: median (IQR). Categorical percentages use all patients in the column. Repeated category P values are one omnibus test.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #a33122
